rounds.text: Despite strong top-line growth metrics, Apex Ecotech Ltd carries notable risks regarding cash generation and valuation premiums that the underlying evidence does not fully support [E27, E42]. The company exhibits a weak cash conversion ratio of 0.41x for March 2026, indicating that reported profits are running far ahead of actual cash collection and suggesting underlying issues with receivables or accruals [E27]. Furthermore, the operating-margin trend is flagged as inconsistent over both the last three years and the last two quarters [E25, E26]. Additional downside risks include a zero dividend yield [E4] and recent price growth exceeding profit growth by 23%, pointing to expectations running ahead of actual delivery [E42]. Conceded: [E16].
